_consumed_by: mChatAI+ macOS AIVidRecorder (AIVidAutoEditConfig.swift) — RULE #1 content; zero-rebuild
_notes: Tune the filler list / silence thresholds / optional AI-polish prompt here. The binary carries only a frozen _fallback_only copy for offline first launch; every value is clamped on load so a bad edit cannot over-cut or disable the editor.

llm_prompt.system: You are a precise video editor. You are given a speaker's transcript as a numbered list of words. Some are flagged as candidate filler words (marked with *). Return ONLY the indices that are TRUE disfluencies (meaningless filler / false starts) — never words that carry meaning in context (e.g. 'like' in a comparison, 'right' as agreement, 'so' as a connector).

_screen_activity_notes: A pause is cut only where the screen is also still, so a demo keeps the stretches where an agent works on screen. Frames are compared grey at analysis_width, samples_per_sec times a second; a pixel counts as changed past pixel_delta (0-255), and the screen counts as moving when changed_fraction of pixels change. Calibrated 2026-10-28 on a 20-minute Workbench demo: changes are mostly exactly zero or large, and 0.001-0.005 all keep about the same, so 0.002 sits in the flat middle. Changing samples_per_sec, analysis_width or pixel_delta makes each recording measure again once; the other values apply instantly.
_voice_leveller_notes: The Video Recorder's voice chain: rumble filter (highpass_hz) -> background-noise expander (starts gate_above_floor_db over the measured room noise; a preset's noise_reduction_db is the most it lowers) -> compressor (threshold relative to the voice's own loudness, light_threshold_db at compression 0 to heavy_threshold_db at 1; ratio 1:1 to heavy_ratio) -> make-up gain to target_lufs as played -> true-peak limiter at ceiling_db. YouTube plays uploads at about -14 LUFS and never turns a quiet one up. Calibrated 2026-10-28 on a 20-minute webcam-mic demo (-30.4 LUFS in): every preset measured -14.0 LUFS / -1.0 dBTP in ffmpeg ebur128; Podcast cut the phrase-to-phrase spread of real speech from 9.7 dB to 5.6 dB. Changing `chain` re-renders every levelled voice once; presets apply to projects that pick them afresh.
_bumpers_notes: Video Recorder intro and outro cards (AIVidBumpers.swift, 2026-10-28). The export adds the cards around the finished video. The words are the user's (the intro starts with the project title, the outro with outro_title). Colours are #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Lengths are clamped to 1-15 s, fades to 0-2 s, zoom (how far the card drifts in over its length) to 0-0.15. The Swift fallback in AIVidAutoEditConfig matches these values.
_blur_notes: Video Recorder Blur (AIVidBlurScanner.swift, 2026-10-28). Find reads the screen recording on the user's Mac (Vision) once per step_sec through the kept video (every move_step_sec where more than move_changed_fraction of the screen changes, from the project's screen-motion measure), at max_frame_width at most (4096: the recording's own size; at 1920 a 3456-wide recording's sidebar titles misread, measured 2026-10-28), and blurs what each pattern matches (just the matched words, grown by pad of their height) plus the user's own words (their whole line). A pattern that doesn't compile (NSRegularExpression) is skipped. Reads are joined into tracks: a spot that stays put is held over missed reads for up to bridge_sec; a spot that moved between two reads is blurred over the whole path between its two places. Clamps: step 0.25-5 s, move step 0.1 s to step, moving share 0.0005-0.5, bridge 0-15 s, width 960-4096, pad 0-2. The Swift fallback matches.
